book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Yesu na Zakayo
Yesu akajingi mu muchi wa Yeliko na kupeta pachilanda ja muchi hoghu.
Konikola kukabhi na mundu jumu lihina laki Zakayo, joakabhi nkolongwa wa bhajopa kode, na mwanahindu yamaheli.
Jonihoju akapaliki kumbona Yesu kubha mundu wa ntundu bhole, nambu kwa ndandi akabhi mundu njipi, ngacheaweziki kumbona maghambu bhandu bhakabhi bhamaheli.
Bhela akakembili kubhalongulela bhandu, na kukwela mnani ja nkongu wa mtini nahuli ambona Yesu, maghambu Yesu anahika kwa kupete indela jenijela.
Yesu paakahikiki pandu panipala, akalingali mnani na kumpwaghila, “Zakayo, uhuluka manyata, ndandi laleno imbalika kupilakila munyumba jako.”
Bhela Zakayo akahulwiki manyata, akahelili na kunjopale kwa chiheku chikolongwa.
Bhandu bhokapi bhabhaghaweni ghanihagha bhakatumbwi kung'ong'uteka bhakapwaghaje, “Apiti kutama kwaka mundu mwana mahoku!”

Nambu Zakayo akajemi na kumpwaghi Bambo, “Lingalyaje, Bambo! Ananabhapekya bhahochu nusu ja hindu yangu, na ngati nakatoliki chindu chaka mundu kwa kukolowa, ananunkelabhukya mala pachechi pa chindu chaki.”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Lalenu ukengaleku ujingi mu nyumba moni, kwa ndandi mundu ajoju najombi nde mwana waka Ibulahimu.
Kwa ndandi Mwana waka Mundu ahikiki kulonda na kukengalela bhandu bhala bhabhahobhiki.”
Ulenganesu wa bhatumika kome

Bhandu pabhajowini malobhi ghanihagha, Yesu akajonjuki kupwagha kwa ulenganesu, maghambu akabhi pambipi na muchi wa Yelusalemu, na bhandu bhala bhahambukya kubha Ukolongwa waka Chapanga uhika chikahi chelachela.
Bhela akabhapwaghile, “Kukabhi na mundu jumu wa lukolu lwa kikolongwa joakapiti ku inchi ja kutali nahuli akajopalya ukolongwa na kukelabhuka.
Bhela paakabhi akona ngakubhoka, akabhalohiki bhatumika bhaki komi na kubhapeke mbija kila jumu wabhu na kubhapwaghila, ‘Muhemala hindu na kulombesa mbaka panikelebhukaje.’
Nambu bhandu bha muchi waki bhakatehi kunhakalila, na bhela bhakabhatumiki bhabholu bhajenda bhakapwaghaje, ‘Ngachetumpala mundu ajoju atutawalaje.’
“Nambu mundu jola akaupatiki ukolongwa na kukelabhuka. Akabhalohiki bhatumika bhala bhaakabhapeki mbija nahuli apata kumanya kila mundu apatiki nyonjeka bhole.
Mtumika wa kutumbula akahikiki na kupwagha, ‘Bambo, mbatiki nyonjeka komi yengi ya mbija yewambekie.’
Jombi akumpwaghile, ‘Uhengiki wichu, wenga wantumika wambone! Maghambu ukabhi undongwana kwa chindu kichoku, nukubheka ubya unkolongwa wa michi komi.’
Mtumika wa kabheli akahikiki na kupwagha, ‘Bambo, mbatiki nyonjeka nhwanu nakanopi kwa mbija jewambekie.’
Jombi akampwaghile, ‘Na wenga bhelabhela nukubheka ubya unkolongwa wa michi nhwano.’
“Mtumika wa katatu akahikiki na kupwagha, ‘Bambo, jenje nde mbija jaku, jenakajihiiki wichu mu chitambala.
Nukujoghupa wehapa, maghambu wa mundu unkale. Wenga wa mundu we utola yangakubha yaku na kuhuna yangakupanda.’
Bambo waki akampwaghile, ‘Wehapa wa mtumika muhakao! Nukutemula kubhokana na malobhi ghaku! Wamanyiki kubha nepani na mundu nunkali, nendola hindu yangu na kuhuna yangakupanda.
Bho, maghambu ja kyane ngachewabhei mbija jangu kubenki, nahuli lichobha la kukelebhuka kwangu nakapata mbija jangu papamu na nyonjeka jake?’
“Bhela akabhapwaghi bhabhajemi pambipi, ‘Munyaghula mbija heji kuhuma kwaki na mukumpekya jola joapatiki nyonjokela komi.’
Bhombi bhakumpwaghile, ‘Nambu Bambo, jonihoju abhi nayu tayale nyonjeka komi!’
Jombi akayangiki, ‘Kila mundu joabhi na chindu anajonjukiwa chengi, nambu mundu jwangakubha na chindu ananyaghulika hata kichokopi cheabhi naku.
Henu kwa bhala maadui bhangu, bhangakupala nepani mya nunkolongwa wabhu, mwabhaleta pambani, na mwakoma palongi jangu!’ ”
Yesu ajingila ku Yelusalemu kwa chiheku chikolongwa
Yesu paakajomwi kulonge malobhi ghanihagha, akabhalonguli palongi jabhu na kujenda ku Yelusalemu.
Paakaheghali kuhika ku Besifage na ku Besania pambipi na Chitombi cha Mizeituni, Yesu akabhatumiki bhabheli pachilanda ja bhabhulwa bhaki,
na kubhapwaghila, “Njendanya ku chijiji chela chemukibhona, pamkahika konikola mkalihimanya liponda likongakiki na njeta mundu joalabhali kujendela. Mukalibhopula na kulileta pambane.
Ngati mundu anaandalukile, ‘Maghambu ki mulibhopo liponda heli?’ Mumpwaghila, ‘Bambo alipala.’ ”
Bhela bhala bhabhatumakiki kujenda bhakahimani kila chindu kibhi ngati Yesu moakapwaghile.
Pabhakabhi bhalibhopo liponda lela, bheni labhu bhakabhalalukile, “Ndandi ki mulibhopo liponda heli?”
Bhakayangiki, “Bambo alipala.”
Bhela bhakalipeliki kwaka Yesu liponda lela, na bhandu bhakatandiki ingobhu yabhu pangongu wa liponda na kunkwea Yesu panani jaki.
Paakabhi ajendalela na mwanja, bhandu bhakatandiki ingobhu yabhu mwindela.

Paakabhi pambipi na muchi wa Yelusalemu, punhelelu wa Chitombi cha Mizeituni, lipogha lokapi la bhabhulwa bhakahekalili na kundumbali Chapanga kwa kujamalila, kwa ndandi ja ngangachu yokapi yebhiwene.
Bhakapwaghaje, “Apengalikaje Nkolongwa joahika kwa lihina laka Bambo! Lukwali kunani kumahunde na ulumbalilu kunani nakanope!”
Bhela Mafalisayo bhangi bhabhakabhi panipala papamu na lipogha la bhandu lela bhakumpwaghi Yesu, “Mbola, ubhalakalyaje bhabhulwa bhaku bhatumbalaje!”
Yesu akabhayangike, “Numpwaghi mabhanganya, anangati bhandu abhabha anabhatumbile, maganga aghagha anaghajamalyaje.”
Yesu aulelela muchi wa Yelusalemu
Yesu paakaheghali ku Yelusalemu na kuubhona muchi, akaulelile,
akapwaghaje, “Ngati wenga ukamanyiki lalenu mambu ghaghaleta lukwali! Nambu sajenu mambu hagha ghahiyakika pamihu jaku.
Maghambu machobha ghahika maadui bhaku pabhichenga lumatu, anabhukuyongalutaje, na kukuhinya ipambala yokapi.
Pabhakuyagha wenga papamu na bhana bhaku mu lumatu lwaku. Ngabhakulekeli hata lighanga limu panani ja lengi, maghambu ngachewamanyi chikahi Chapanga paakahiki kukukengalela!”
Yesu ajenda pa Nyumba jaka Chapanga
Bhela Yesu akapiti pa Nyumba jaka Chapanga na kutumbu kubhapiha kunja bhabhahemela na kulombesa.
Jombi akabhapwaghile, “Ilembakiki mu Malembu Mahuhu, ‘Nyumba jangu anajibya nyumba ja malobhu.’ Nambu mwanganya mujibhei kubha likolu la bhanyaghula!”
Yesu akabhi abhola kila lichobha pa Nyumba jaka Chapanga. Nambu bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa, bhabhola bha Shelia papamu na bhakolongwa bha bhandu bhakalondiki indela ja kunkoma,
nambu ngachebhapatiki indela ja kunkoma, maghambu bhandu bhokapi bhakabhi bhunjowanela kwa wichu nakanopi.
